commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

_note: Two OCA editions of one hymn. The base is the OCA service-texts DOCX (reference/scrape/2024-11-08.docx, "Prepared by the Department of Liturgical Music and Translations"); the parish sings the OCA engraved-music setting (© 2019 OCA) printed in its choir packet. Register is NOT the whole difference and a ?pronoun=yy render does not reach this wording — see memory project_register_knob_is_service_wide.

_provenance.family_note: OCA. The OCA service-texts DOCX; identical to the stichera row it stands in for.

value.text:
Destroy the wanton violence of Hagar’s sons— the enemies who unceasingly attack thy flock; heal the divisions of the Church, calm the storm of unending temptations; from danger and calamities deliver us who honor thee in love and who hasten to thy protection, O Chief Captain Gabriel,
thou intercessor for our souls!

variants.label: OCA engraved-music setting, as the parish sings it

Tone 4, position (1). Colophon on the packet's last page: "© 2019 Orthodox Church in America". Read VISUALLY from the scan, not from the OCR sidecar. Chant marks (//) kept as printed; the director's pencil underlay marks are melodic, not textual, and are not transcribed.

value.text:
Destroy the wanton violence of Hagar's sons:
the enemies who attack your flock;
heal the divisions of the Church,
calm the storm of unending temptations;
deliver from danger and calamities
those who honor you in love,
and hasten to your protection, Gabriel the archangel,//
the intercessor for our souls!
